You think Star Wars sounds came from a computer. They came from a bear, an elephant, and an old TV.
Sound designer Ben Burtt recorded real things.

text: Guess: which one came from a hammer? Comment one, two or three.

The lightsaber hum? An old film projector motor, mixed with the buzz of a TV.
Chewbacca's voice? Mostly a young bear, mixed with other animals.
The tie fighter scream? A changed elephant call.
R two D two? Half synthesizer, half Ben's own voice.

text: And the blaster? A hammer hitting the steel wire of a radio tower. Number two.
The most famous space sounds came from Earth.
Would you have guessed the bear? Yes or no.
